items.example: He found a winning ticket on his car and won the lottery.
The couple are ten million dollars richer today.

items.translation: деньги растут как грибы / у нас тут золотое дно
items.example: He thinks money grows on trees — he has never worked a day.
He thought he was the unluckiest person in town.

items.idiom: be in the right place at the right time
items.translation: оказаться в нужном месте в нужное время
items.example: He was in the right place at the right time — and he picked up the ticket.
I think I'll give the concert a miss this year.
They didn't want to change their lives, so they started from scratch.
